intro: Orane blends durability with contemporary design, enhanced with a full-length mirror. Featuring a built-in locker, shelves, and a hanger, it offers secure, all-in-one storage with all-day convenience.

features.title: Premium crca steel construction
features.text: Designed from Cold Rolled Close Annealed (CRCA) steel with advanced powder coating, Orane delivers exceptional strength and resilience. The steel body resists moisture, prevents rust, and remains termite-proof, ensuring long-lasting performance.

features.title: Full-length mirror for everyday convenience
features.text: A sleek, integrated mirror on the door adds functional ease to daily routines. It eliminates the need for a separate dressing mirror while visually enhancing the room with added depth and light.

features.title: Two-way locking system for enhanced security
features.text: The wardrobe features a secure two-way locking mechanism on the main doors, complemented by an internal locker with a separate key. This dual-layer protection safeguards valuables like jewellery, documents, and important belongings.

features.title: Multiple storage configurations
features.text: Sturdy internal shelves combined with a dedicated hanging space accommodate folded garments, accessories, and full-length clothing. This thoughtful layout keeps storage organised while maintaining a clutter-free interior.

features.title: Dust-prevention door design
features.text: Specialised door detailing prevents dust infiltration, helping keep stored items clean and fresh. This design protects clothing and valuables while reducing cleaning frequency.

features.title: Integrated recessed handle
features.text: Sleek recessed handles go well with the wardrobe surface, creating smooth, contemporary lines. The ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic.

care: Wipe your steel almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
